chapter: Hutto 1978-79: NBC, radio and the N'goma drums
title: Saturday Night Swing Club and Leith Stevens
summary: Asked about the CBS Saturday Night Swing Club, he recalls nightly guests such as Bunny Berigan and says he played on the orchestra's records.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: On the Saturday Night Swing Club, was that program off for several years? I remember it but not definitely.
No; that was always on Saturday night.
But most every night we had a guest like Bunny Berigan And it just changed our style for that tune alone. And then everybody would applaud him. He was great, just absolutely great.
Now the Leith Stevens Band made four sides for Vocalion. Were you on that?
And the Saturday Night Swing Club, the orchestra made four records.
It it was the Saturday Night Swing Club, I was on it.
